name: Umbria
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate: Sangiovese, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Indicazione Geografica Tipica, Italy's broad regional tier.

notes: Orvieto is mostly a dry white, with small amounts of off-dry and sweet wine.
Montefalco Sagrantino, from thick-skinned Sagrantino aged long in oak, is typically very dense and full bodied, with very high tannin.
A sweet passito Sagrantino is also made, and sweet wines were the grape's main use in the past.

blurb.text: A region of Italy with appellations such as Montefalco Sagrantino, Torgiano, Spoleto and Rosso Orvietano. Its vineyards grow mostly Sangiovese, Trebbiano Toscano and Grechetto di Orvieto, followed by Merlot and Sagrantino.
